content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) Fortran source of FUNWAVE-TVD io.F: input reading and all screen/station/field output, seven subroutines. SUBROUTINE OUTPUT (L63-97): accumulates SCREEN_COUNT/PLOT_COUNT_STATION/PLOT_COUNT by DT and calls STATISTICS (L72) every SCREEN_INTV, STATIONS (L80) every PLOT_INTV_STATION when NumberStations>0, and PREVIEW (L90) every PLOT_INTV once TIME>=PLOT_START_TIME. SUBROUTINE READ_INPUT (L112-2338, history L104-108: Shi 01/2011, Choi intel option 12/23/2014, Zhouteng Ye command-line input file + post-processor 07/17/2019): gets MPI size/rank (L134-135), opens unit 10000 'time_dt.out' (L138) and unit 3 'LOG.txt' (L140), takes the input file name from command argument via GETARG defaulting to 'input.txt' (L148-154), then reads every model parameter with READ_STRING/READ_INTEGER/READ_FLOAT/READ_LOGICAL from module INPUT_READ, each with either a hard requirement (message + MPI_FINALIZE + STOP) or a default assignment, logging everything to LOG.txt (see params_defined for the full enumeration with defaults and line anchors). Sections in order: TITLE (L157-161, default '---TEST RUN---' @L160); PARALLEL PX/PY; GRID Mglob/Nglob/DX/DY; DEPTH (DAT/FLA/SLO with DEPTH_FILE/DEPTH_FLAT/SLP/Xslp) and BATHY_CORRECTION; TIME (TOTAL_TIME, PLOT/SCREEN intervals, StationOutputBuffer); HOT START (INI_UVZ, BED_DEFORMATION, ETA/U/V/MASK files, HotStartTime, OutputStartNumber); STILL WATER (WaterLevel); WAVEMAKER — branches for LEF_SOL, WK_TIME, INI_SOL, N_WAVE, INI_REC, INI_GAU/INI_DIP, WK_REG, WK_IRR/TMA_1D/JON_1D/JON_2D spectral parameters, ETA_LIMITER with CrestLimit/TroughLimit, WK_NEW_DATA2D/WK_DATA2D (Salatin et al. 2021, JGR Oceans doi 10.1029/2021JC017641, citation L2134-2138), EqualEnergy, and ABS/LEFT_BC_IRR absorbing-generating wavemaker: WAVE_DATA_TYPE with DATA branch that opens WaveCompFile (L1258) and reads NumFreq/NumDir, PeakPeriod, Per_Ser (as frequency, inverted to period 1/f @L1304 with zero-frequency STOP @L1300-1303), Theta_Ser (deg->rad @L1308), Amp_Ser, optional Phase_LEFT (END=991 fallthrough sets INPUT_PHASE via labels 881/991 @L1278-1279; phases converted deg->rad @L1285 or randomized rand(0)*2*pi @L1287), and allocates Phase_Ser/Segma_Ser/Wave_Number_Ser (L1295-1297), versus a TMA/JON branch re-reading spectral parameters (L1316-1398); PERIODIC BC; SPONGE (DIFFUSION/DIRECT/FRICTION with Csp/CDsponge/widths/R_sponge/A_sponge); WaveMakerCd momentum-balance friction (L1560-1567); OBSTACLE_FILE/BREAKWATER_FILE/BreakWaterAbsorbCoef; PHYSICS (DISPERSION, Gamma1/2/3, Beta_ref, VISCOSITY_BREAKING with ROLLER override @L1677, SWE_ETA_DEP, friction IN_Cd/CD_FILE/Cd_fixed); NUMERICS (Time_Scheme, CONSTR, HIGH_ORDER, CFL, DT_fixed->FIXED_DT, FroudeCap); MinDepth/MinDepthFrc merged to their minimum per Harris 11/13/2023 (L1821-1823); arrival time OUT_Time/ArrTimeMin (Lauren); WAVE BREAKING (ROLLER_EFFECT->ROLLER_SWITCH, SHOW_BREAKING, Cbrk1/Cbrk2, WAVEMAKER_Cbrk, WAVEMAKER_VIS with visbrk/WAVEMAKER_visbrk and a VISCOSITY_BREAKING+WAVEMAKER_VIS conflict block L1950-1957 that calls MPI_FINALIZE without STOP); WAVE-AVERAGED (T_INTV_mean, STEADY_TIME, C_smg); nu_bkg; OUTPUT INFO (RESULT_FOLDER created via CALL SYSTEM('mkdir -p ...') @L2042-2046, FIELD_IO_TYPE (mayhl), NumberStations/STATIONS_FILE, OUTPUT_RES, 37 OUT_* logical flags L2065-2101, dead EtaBlowVal default block L2103-2111 whose READ_FLOAT is commented out); and the WK_NEW_IRR coherent-wavemaker block (L2165-2333) reading spectral parameters plus alpha_c wave-coherence percentage (Salatin et al. 2021). SUBROUTINE STATIONS (L2350-2460, Shi 09/16/2011 after Jeff Harris; stations given as grid i,j): on first call allocates ista/jsta/nsta and a ZUV buffer (StationOutputBuffer,NumberStations,4), checks STATIONS_FILE exists (L2382), reads station grid coordinates converting to local tile indices ista(i)=Nghost+dum1-(iista-1) (ykchoi Jan/23/2018, L2396-2397), opens per-station files 'sta_NNNN' (unit 100+i, L2401-2405); each call buffers time/eta/u/v (zeroed at masked cells L2418-2421) and flushes the buffer with format (E21.10E4,3E16.5E4) when full (L2427-2440); closes files at TIME>=TOTAL_TIME (L2450-2458). SUBROUTINE PREVIEW (L2473-2657, Choi 5-digit file numbers 06/01/2015): increments ICOUNT, builds 5-digit suffix (L2500-2510), writes dep.out and cd_breakwater.out on first frame (L2513-2519), writes time,dt to unit 10000 (L2521), then PutFile field snapshots gated by OUT_* flags: eta_, hmax_, hmin_, umax_, MFmax_, VORmax_, u_, v_, mask_, mask9_ (via Int2Flo), p_, q_ (interior 1:Mloc,1:Nloc), age_, roller_, U_undertow_/V_undertow_, nubrk_ (VISCOSITY_BREAKING), FrcInsX_/FrcInsY_, BrkSrcX_/BrkSrcY_, time_ (ARRTIME), tmp_ (L2524-2652). SUBROUTINE PREVIEW_MEAN (L2666-2770, Shi 03/22/2016): increments ICOUNT_MEAN, writes umean_/ulagm_ (ulagm=P_mean/Max(Depth+ETAmean,MinDepthFrc) @L2701), vmean_/vlagm_, etamean_, Hrms_/Havg_/Hsig_, and under OUT_Radiation the radiation-stress set Sxx=UUmean-WWmean+0.5*9.8*ETA2mean (L2730), Sxy=UVmean, Syy=VVmean-WWmean+0.5*9.8*ETA2mean (L2735), plus DxSxx_..DxUVH_, FRCX_/FRCY_, BrkDissX_/BrkDissY_ (L2738-2765). SUBROUTINE GetFile(FILE,PHI) (L2782-2880, Choi 05/08/2017 MPI version): rank 0 reads the whole global array into PHIGLOB with ghost-cell edge copying (L2801-2824), gathers each rank's tile indices via MPI_Gather (L2834-2841), keeps its own tile (L2843-2845) and sends each other rank its tile slice with mpi_isend/mpi_irecv+mpi_wait (L2847-2874). SUBROUTINE PutFile(FILE_NAME,PHI) (L2892-2912): dispatches on FIELD_IO_TYPE to PutFileASCII or PutFileBinary (module PARALLEL_FIELD_IO), defaulting to ASCII.

calls: CALL STATISTICS @L72; CALL STATIONS @L80; CALL PREVIEW @L90
CALL MPI_COMM_SIZE @L134; CALL MPI_COMM_RANK @L135; CALL GETARG(1,INPUT_NAME) @L148
READ_STRING/READ_INTEGER/READ_FLOAT/READ_LOGICAL from module INPUT_READ throughout READ_INPUT (first uses @L157,@L171,@L213,@L312)
call MPI_FINALIZE on every missing required parameter (e.g. @L196,@L521,@L1956,@L2172) and CALL MPI_FINALIZE @L2387 in STATIONS
GetFile: call MPI_Gather x4 @L2834-2841; mpi_isend @L2860; mpi_wait @L2861,@L2871; mpi_irecv @L2870
PutFile: CALL PutFileASCII @L2904 (and default @L2909); Call PutFileBinary @L2906

verbatim_spans.text: !  merge two parameters into the minimum one, change to min according to Harris 11/13/2023

unresolved: EtaBlowVal block L2103-2111: the READ_FLOAT is commented out (@L2104) but the IF(ierr==1) default EtaBlowVal=10.0_SP remains, keyed to the stale ierr of the preceding OUT_Radiation read (@L2101); init.f90 later overwrites EtaBlowVal=100*max depth — cross-line/cross-file dead-code interaction
VISCOSITY_BREAKING=T + WAVEMAKER_VIS=T conflict block (L1950-1957) calls MPI_FINALIZE but has no STOP statement, unlike every other fatal branch — execution continues after finalize

IF(ROLLER) VISCOSITY_BREAKING=.TRUE. at L1677 executes before ROLLER is read at L1868 — the override uses ROLLER's pre-read (module default) value, so ROLLER_EFFECT set in input cannot force VISCOSITY_BREAKING here

V_FILE ELSE branch (L1445-1448... i.e. L444-448 of chunk: NO_UV_FILE=.FALSE. @L446 then IF(NO_UV_FILE) NO_UV_FILE=.TRUE. @L447) — the guard is a no-op after the preceding assignment, and a present V_FILE resets NO_UV_FILE=.FALSE. even if U_FILE was absent
CONSTR default is the string 'HLLC' (@L1753) while its log message says 'USE HLL' (@L1752); consumers test only CONSTR(1:3)=='HLL' so both behave as HLL

unit 10000 'time_dt.out' is opened (@L138) before RESULT_FOLDER is read (@L2021), so it lands in the CWD, and FDIR=TRIM(RESULT_FOLDER) at L137 uses RESULT_FOLDER before it is read — premature/dead assignment in READ_INPUT
STATIONS station-file suffix is written with write(file_name(1:4),'(I4.4)') i (@L2402) into FILE_NAME whose remainder stays blank — 4-digit station names vs 5-digit field-file names in PREVIEW

labels 881/991 (L1278-1279): 881 INPUT_PHASE=.TRUE. is reachable only by fallthrough after the Phase_LEFT read loop completes; no GOTO 881 exists in the file — whether INPUT_PHASE correctly reflects a phase-less file relies on READ END=991 skipping 881, an easily-broken control-flow idiom
rand(0) (@L1287) is a compiler-specific extension; DEG2RAD, LARGE, ZERO, SP and all GLOBAL variables are defined cross-file
locals LINE, I_comp, MKFOLDER(after L2042), FILE_NAME_MEAN (@L2480), TMP_NAME in PutFile (@L2900) are declared but unused or write-only
STATISTICS and PutFileASCII/PutFileBinary and READ_* parsers are defined in other files (cross-file)
